about: The alleluia of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Alleluia, alleluia. Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.

alignments.gloss: Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed

w005.explanation: Christus is the subject. Pascha nostrum identifies Him as our Passover, and immolatus est means “has been sacrificed”.
